name: BioticFlux
description: The quantum heart of the ecosystem. Sun and moon cycle through wheat and mushroom growth, while matter flows through detritus and death.

name: CyberDebtMegacity
description: A sprawling cyberpunk megacity where debt fuels the neon lights and criminal syndicates rule from towering spires. Spaceships dock in skyports amid a haze of digital crime and endless obligations. Everyone owes someone. The pulse of arriving rockets marks the rhythm of commerce; the chains of debt mark everything else.

name: EchoingChasm
description: A labyrinth of resonant canyons where forgotten songs unravel reality. Faint bells toll in the wind, webs of memory trap the unwary, and identities fade into silent graves under a perpetual twilight. The acoustics here amplify dissolution—what the Chorus sings, the walls remember and repeat until meaning erodes.

name: FungalNetworks
description: Networked fungal colonies thrive in moonlight and moisture, spreading through insects and spores, cycling between health and death.

name: HorizonFracture
description: Fractured rifts at the world's edge, where planets dissolve into swirling voids. Boundaries blur between something and nothing, with fleeting stars guiding nomads through probabilistic paths amid decaying horizons. The Cartographers chart what they can; the Black Horizon claims the rest.

name: StarterForest
description: A quiet forest edge where celestial cycles drive life. Sun and moon oscillate above while creatures and plants dance between survival and growth.

name: StellarForges
description: Industrial space. Energy cycles through power and storage while production shifts between active fabrication and raw materials, outputting rockets and saucers.

name: Village
description: A farming settlement where fire and ice oscillate in hearths, labor produces bread, and gears grind flour into commerce.

name: VolcanicWorlds
description: Extreme geology. Fire forges stone into crystal while mining and steam shape the environment into glowing vitality.

name: TidalPools
description: A liminal shore where cosmic tides expose and submerge quantum states in eternal rhythm. The spiral pools are natural measurement apparatuses—when the moon floods them, coherence spreads; when it drains, probability collapses and the stranded reveal their fates. The environment doesn't choose sides. It simply processes.

name: BureaucraticAbyss
description: The machine that processes billions. Not evil—evil requires intention. Simply thorough. Edicts descend from the Gilded Rot above, pass through endless functionaries, and eventually produce outcomes: transfers, terminations, deaths. The archives grow. The graves fill. The signatures never stop.

name: GildedRot
description: The eternal party above the grinding machine. Wine flows, masks smile, roses bloom in impossible colors. The aristocracy has danced here for so long they've forgotten there's a below—or perhaps they remember perfectly and find it amusing. Blood-tribute rises through hidden channels, transformed into vintage. Edicts descend like party favors, each one a death sentence wrapped in calligraphy.

name: BroadcastTower
description: A crackling relay station at the edge of coherence. Signals propagate through antenna arrays, degrade into static, fragment into noise. The tower hums with transmissions that may or may not reach their destinations. What cannot be heard is eventually forgotten.

name: SatelliteGraveyard
description: Orbital debris field where dead satellites tumble in eternal silence among dying stars. Recorded data corrupts slowly in the radiation bath. Nothing is recovered here—only preserved in degraded form, waiting for the void to claim it.

name: Clinic
description: Sterile light hums above examination tables. Treatments expire on shelves. Diagnosis leads inexorably to prohibition or intervention. The genetics persist long after the patient is gone—the only true record of what was attempted here.

name: Workshop
description: The honest entropy of labor. Hammers ring in steady rhythm. Tools wear down with use, are repaired, wear down again. Everything here serves a purpose until it doesn't, then joins the cycle of salvage and reuse.

name: ScrapYard
description: The terminal basin. Everything ends here eventually—machinery, materials, workers. The 🗑 grows ever larger. But from decay comes recycling, and from recycling, raw material flows back into the world. Even endings feed beginnings.

name: MarketDistrict
description: Hub of commerce where goods become money and money becomes obligation. Bulls and bears pace the trading floors while businessmen cut deals in shadowed alcoves. Everything has a price tag. Everything flows toward or away from wealth.

name: TradingFloor
description: Pure speculation distilled. Bulls charge, bears retreat, charts rise and crash. Yesterday's analysis is worthless today. The floor is a fever dream of numbers that mean everything and nothing.

name: WeaversLoft
description: Threads fray under patient fingers. Garments take shape, wear out, return to thread. Needles pierce and bind. Knots hold—until they don't. The loft smells of lanolin and old cloth, and nothing here is ever truly finished.

name: BindingCircle
description: A small sacred space where oaths are knotted into permanence. Prayer beads count the bindings. Candles witness the promises. What is tied here does not easily come undone—but nothing lasts forever, not even vows.

name: MeditationGarden
description: Lantern light flickers over still water. Breathing slows. The attempt to hold coherence against the constant pull of dissolution. Enlightenment is an attractor state—difficult to reach, stable once achieved, but the lights always fade eventually.

name: OccultSanctum
description: Warding magic hums in the shadows. The evil eye watches from every corner, deflecting what should not enter. Candles and lanterns mark the protective boundaries. The ashes of guardian spirits rest in urns along the walls.

name: ShrineOfAshes
description: Where the cremated rest. Final rites are performed by candlelight, prayers strung on beads that outlast the prayers themselves. The dead flow in; only memory flows out. A quiet terminus for those who burned.

name: PastoralCommons
description: Flocks graze on common land. Bees drift between wildflowers. Porridge simmers over low fires while gentle hands shape the future. A peaceful place—but peace is fragile, and predators are always circling.

name: Apiary
description: Hives hum with focused industry. Honey accumulates in jars, beginning its slow transformation. The bees know their work; the keepers know theirs. A small, sweet place where fermentation begins.

name: Harbor
description: Salt air and creaking rope. Vessels rest at anchor while rust accumulates on hooks and chains. Ice melts in bilgewater. The harbor is a pause between voyages—a place where things wait, and waiting has its own entropy.

name: FreshwaterSpring
description: Source water wells up from deep stone. Ice melts at the margins. Bubbles rise and pop in an instant. This is where water begins its journey through the world—fundamental, flowing, feeding everything downstream.

name: Battlefield
description: Steel meets steel in thunder and blood. Shields splinter. Explosions tear the air. The dead pile up, awaiting the ash-brothers who will give them proper ending. This is where violence concentrates, fast and hot and hungry.

name: RevolutionSquare
description: Fists raised against the sky. Flags snap in the wind. Manifestos are shouted to crowds who may or may not be listening. Movements coalesce here, burn bright, and fragment. The bureaucrats watch from distant windows.

name: OrbitalStrike
description: A space combat biome armed by the presence of a carrier (🛸). When the strike (💥) detonates, it consumes the carrier as its trigger: the Lindblad feedback 🛸→void gated by 💥² is self-erasing. After a single firing, the biome's primary reservoir is gone; the biome cannot re-arm without external resupply. One-shot weapon, reloaded only from outside. A quest that triggers OrbitalStrike is consumable — the biome is a different biome after the fight.

name: Archives
description: Records accumulate in endless stacks. Filing systems slowly fail. Precedent decays into ambiguity. The scales of justice gather dust. Here, knowledge persists imperfectly—better than memory, worse than truth.

name: AbandonedQuarter
description: What remains when power withdraws. Crumbling monuments to forgotten purposes. Empty urns that once held meaning. Stone slowly claims what was built upon it. Time moves differently here—geological, patient, absolute.

name: ForgottenCastle
description: The party ended centuries ago. Edicts yellow on the walls. Eagles circle the towers, waiting for scraps that no longer come. Roses have wilted into memory. What was once the seat of power is now a monument to its absence.

name: DemolitionSite
description: Controlled destruction. Dynamite cracks. Flames consume. Bricks scatter. What took years to build comes down in moments. A necessary violence that clears the way for what comes next.

name: Woodlot
description: Timber country. Axes ring against trunks. Trees become lumber become firewood become ash. The forest gives and the forest takes, and the cycle turns with every swing of the blade.

name: MirrorChamber
description: A space of reflection—literal and otherwise. Candlelight flickers across silvered glass. Shadows gather in corners. The self observes the self observing. Identity becomes uncertain here, and what looks back may not be what looks in.

name: TrappersCamp
description: Where hunters wait. Snares are set in careful patterns. Hooks bait the unwary. Rabbits wander in; bones remain. A patient, predatory place where capture is the craft and remains are the record.

name: EnforcementPost
description: Law's presence, however temporary. Patrol cars wait. Keys jingle on belts that may unlock or bind. Chains rattle in holding cells. Clipboards track the processed. Authority asserts itself here—until the shift ends.

name: PowerStation
description: The grid's heart. Electricity hums through transformers. Batteries charge and discharge. Gears turn generators. Connections fail and are repaired in endless cycles. The Kilowatt Collective keeps the lights on—usually.

name: MagneticAnomaly
description: Something wrong with the local physics. Compasses spin. Instruments give impossible readings. Vortices form in electromagnetic fields. Signals bend around the anomaly's heart. A small, strange place where the rules are merely suggestions.

name: AntimatterFoundry
description: Where annihilation is harvested. Void-stuff and starlight collide in magnetic containment. The energy released is beyond measure—and so is the danger. When containment fails, the void claims its due. This is where the Black Horizon's physics are put to work.

name: ColdLab
description: A controlled micro-biome for low-entropy measurement loops. Useful for consistent probe regression runs.

name: VillagePocket
description: A tiny market loop tuned for starter economy tests and delivery quest throughput.

name: StellarSeed
description: A minimal cosmic test patch that links signal-space to luminous symbols under mild decoherence.

name: AshPatch
description: A compact high-dissipation patch for stress testing unstable routes and low-resource recovery.

name: ThePrecession
description: A cosmic threshold where probability starts to unwind. Observers fix telescopes on fading stars while the dim hub at the center turns quietly through its rotations — each axis pivoting at its own phase. Drawn too close, one orbit stops returning.

name: WeaversCant
description: A domestic hush where knots keep oaths and candles keep time. Every gesture in this room rotates the ward at its center — not by much, but constantly. Outsiders feel watched and cannot say by what.

name: ResonanceHall
description: A stage where synchronized motion becomes physics. The dancers' triangle alone is enough to set the air rotating; the troubadour's second rotation twists the spark at the edge. The audience pumps sound; the show disperses the magic. Both at once.

name: NullingChamber
description: A stargazer's null-detector. The telescope lens is lossy — it leaks photons to the void. But when the Cartographers' map-coupling and the Opalescent void-coupling arrive with phases that interfere destructively, the amplitude on the lens cancels and the light stays trapped between map and anchor forever. A two-faction EIT (dark-state) circuit: if and only if the chiral phases match, the biome goes dark.

name: Lanternfall
description: The coastal watchtower chain. Five lights in a row, spaced by the Lamplighters' alternating rhythm: close-far-close-far. Population pumped in at the flag (🏁) is supposed to flow back down the chain — but doesn't. The chain's bond pattern has a topologically protected zero-energy mode localized at the bridge (🌉), and any amplitude that reaches that eigenstate *stays there*, even when a drain pulls at the other end. The biome is a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger edge-state detector: it reports whether the chain is in its nontrivial topological phase by whether the bridge lantern stays lit.

name: ZenoLatch
description: A single strong link from the Lamplighters' signal chain — the oil-lamp and the horn, coupled by the guild's tightest bond. The horn has a ferocious drain: every puff of breath it carries is lost to the open air. Classical intuition says this drain should accelerate the depletion of the lamp. Quantum mechanics says the opposite: the faster the horn drains, the MORE STRONGLY the lamp's population is pinned in place. Deep in the Zeno regime (Γ/Ω ≈ 15), what should be a full Rabi oscillation is frozen: the lamp stays lit because the universe is watching too closely to let it transfer. In the Lamplighters' ledger this is the 🪔 ↔ 📯 section — one tight chord with a little weather drifting through it.

name: WheelOfHours
description: Three glasses turning on a single wheel, attended by the Timekeepers' one-way sand. A slow pump fills the empty hourglass (⌛), and a slow drain empties the alarm (⏰). Between them, the flowing glass (⏳) sits on the forward path. Because the ring's loop phase is π/2, the current takes the long way around — through the flowing glass, in the direction the guild insists upon — rather than jumping straight across. A built-in clock for the biome, running on chirality.

name: LaserGlint
description: A three-level laser cavity. An external pump feeds sparks (💥) from the void. Each spark tumbles fast into the rainbow (🌈) — this is why the air above the glint always shimmers with colour. But the rainbow's only path downward is through the single taut string that the Prismatic Cascade holds: the coherent 🌈↔🌟 transition. And the star (🌟) at the bottom is bled off into the void as quickly as it arrives. The result is POPULATION INVERSION — more amplitude sitting on the rainbow than on the star — a condition no passive medium can maintain. Seed a whisper of amplitude on the star and it comes back amplified.

name: TwofacedTide
description: A coastal flat where the moon hangs in one of two fixed postures, bright or dim, and switches only when someone pushes. The tide reinforces whichever face already dominates: where the full moon already stands, the waters help it hold; where the waning crescent stands, the waters refuse to kindle anything brighter. Below a critical weather the biome is always dim. Above a critical weather, both postures become simultaneously stable — and the biome SITS IN WHICHEVER ONE IT WAS IN. A push is required to flip it. In gameplay this makes the TwofacedTide a switchable mission gate: quests can ask whether the tide is currently bright or dim, and answering requires knowing its history.

name: BrittleDawn
description: A moon tuned to the knife edge between bright and dim. TwofacedTide has a confident two-phase personality; BrittleDawn has it by the thinnest margin. The pump rate sits just barely above the saddle-node threshold, so the bright phase exists but its stability eigenvalue is nearly zero. Any perturbation takes forever to decay, and a push near the threshold can transition the biome through a corridor of divergent response times. A CRITICAL POINT biome — sensitive to every breath.

name: MnemonicHive
description: A stone shelf with two ledgers, bound in red and green. Their pages are kept by the same silence: whatever is written on one must also be written on the other. The ledgers have a single BISTABLE memory between them — both closed (pens full, books blank) or both open (books inked, pens empty) — and a push on EITHER ledger flips both. One bit of persistent state, worn in two colors. The Archivists insist this is a feature; the red entries and the green entries mean different things, even though they are the same entry. A mission that writes the hive's memory writes it twice.

name: MothGarden
description: A hedge where three appetites contest for the same air. Pump each of them from outside — sun for the butterflies, leaves for the caterpillars, crickets for the spiders — and the populations settle into a rotating dance. The butterflies bloom, the caterpillars suppress the butterflies, the spiders suppress the caterpillars, the butterflies bloom again. The cycle never fully damps: a WATERCLOCK carved out of teeth. In the Lindbladian this is a rock-paper-scissors ring of gated drains, identical in form — the *loop* is the only asymmetry.

name: SporeLibrary
description: A shelf of mushrooms tuned to two different thresholds. The pale register ignites at the faintest disturbance; the orange register demands a stronger push. A weak breath through the library leaves only the pale register lit. A louder breath lights both. Once lit, each register sustains itself; the biome remembers which breath was strongest. Three distinguishable states: silent, whispered, spoken.

name: _orphan_lindblads
description: Collected Lindblad terms for emojis not found in any biome
